messages.subject: Error: items must have unique names in data input provided
parts:

when i run my analysis result is an error. my data is an matrix with no name in column. is it necessary to add name to the column of data?

model2PL <- mirt(data=complete.dat, 1, itemtype='2PL', SE=TRUE, verbose=FALSE)
